summary: I'm failing this change because one acceptance criterion is not met. The prompt edits and the code change both work. The reader, producer and verifier prompts now carry the request's goal, and judge() turns any non-blank request_reading_mismatch into a Major finding that blocks a pass. Two new unit tests cover this, and I ran them and they pass. The budgets test measures the reader set at exactly 1,963 tokens, the study producer at 1,126 and the study verifier at 1,392, matching the new budgets with no margin. fmt and clippy are clean and the full test suite passes. What fails is criterion 8, which asks that other documents stating 1,800 be updated. Two present-tense statements of the old budget remain: docs/design/defaults-loop.md line 47 says "The reader budget is 1,800 tokens", even though that file was edited elsewhere in this change, and docs/design/socratic-review.md line 219 says "The reader's whole always-loaded set is 1,800 tokens". There is also one small scope note: docs/design/athena-v0.md changed but is not on the deliverables list, though the edit is the kind criterion 8 asks for.
